findings.description: The customer-managed KMS key used to protect audit data does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so AWS leaves automatic annual key rotation disabled (the insecure default). Keys that are never rotated retain the same backing material for their entire lifetime, so a single key compromise or leak remains valid indefinitely and all historical audit data encrypted under it stays exposed.
